name: Branch reading
responsibility: Reads the vault as a source branch or commit holds it, from Git, as a model that cannot be edited
description: Reads the vault's inputs as they stand at a source branch or commit of the vault's repository, from Git objects, without a checkout. It decodes them as a model that can be read and compared but not edited, claimed or retained, and its revision names the commit it read.

outgoing.label: decode the inputs at the ref
read the vault's blobs at the commit
